text_block_list.text:
One day, as I passed by the dance studio,
I heard a familiar voice.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Relax your shoulders.
Picture your entire body turning to liquid.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes... Whoaaaa-whoa, whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! You went out of your way to help me with
my independent practice, and I keep messing up...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Not to worry. I teach because I enjoy it.
Just take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I understand it in my head, but...
Whenever I think about having to put on a great concert,
I just tense right up...
choice_data_list: Looks like you're really backed into a corner, huh.
Looks like you're really backed into a corner, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...All right, at times like this—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Practical dance practice right here, right now?! But my dancing isn't ready for anyone to see...!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The crowd's already gathered, so brace yourself!
Shock therapy's the best thing for you right now.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Narita Top Road!
Show me what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Aaaah! Come what mayyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Looking good! Next up is this!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? W-Whoa!
I don't know this choreography...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'll match your lead, so just dance however you like!
Don't let theory hold you back!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: If you dance like that—see? Can't you see the happy looks on everyone's faces?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa! Top Road-saaaan!!
Look over hereee!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Looking good, you two, looking real good!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about skill. What the audience really wants
is a fun time and space shared with you.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to tense up at all!
Come on, let's dance to our hearts' content!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for today!
Dancing is all about having fun, right!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heh, no need for thanks.
I had a thrilling time myself.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I might be the one who should thank you.
Thanks to you, I was able to get back to the basics of dance."
choice_data_list: Practicing like this once in a while seems like a good idea.
Practicing like this once in a while seems like a good idea.
I can't wait for the next concert!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I might be the one who should thank you.
Thanks to you, I was able to get back to the basics of dance."
choice_data_list: Practicing like this once in a while seems like a good idea.
Practicing like this once in a while seems like a good idea.
I can't wait for the next concert!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
I'll be counting on you next time, too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Are you sure?
It would be a huge help, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Call me anytime you want to dance.
I'll be there!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "YEAH! Let's make this the most hype live show ever! Right, Top Road!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I'll make it an extraordinarily fun live concert!
